template.event:
element("buttonId"):SetInt(-1) element("newMenu"):SetInt(0) element("is_new"):SetInt(0)
element("quest_id"):SetInt( -1 ) element("quest_name"):SetString( "" ) element("quest_description"):SetString( "" ) element("quest_highlight"):SetString( "" ) element("quest_sheetId"):SetString("") element("quest_imageId"):SetString("") element("quest_sheetIdLeft"):SetString("") element("quest_imageIdLeft"):SetString("") element("quest_sheetIdBottom"):SetString("") element("quest_imageIdBottom"):SetString("")
element("quest_progress"):SetInt(0)
--[[element("block_interface"):SetVectorStr() element("unblock_interface"):SetVectorStr()]]

if element("quest_type_id"):GetInt()==msg.typeId then
if msg.spriteSheetID~="" and msg.imageID~="" then element["ItemImage"]("spriteName"):Set(msg.imageID) element["ItemImage"]("sheetName"):Set("xml_resources/"..msg.spriteSheetID) end end

element["bg"]("visible"):SetInt(1) element["ItemImage"]("visible"):SetInt(1) element["NewQuest"]("visible"):SetInt( element("is_new"):GetInt() ) element["Touch"]("enabled"):SetInt(1)
local progress = element("quest_progress"):GetInt() if progress ~=0 and progress ~= 100 then element["ProgressText"]("visible"):SetInt(1) element["ProgressText"]("text"):SetString(progress.."%") else element["ProgressText"]("visible"):SetInt(0) end

touchComponent.name: Touch

textComponent.name: ProgressText
textComponent.event:
component("font"):Set("rp_font_title") component("size"):Set(0.7) component("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_HCENTER_ALIGNED)
component("red"):SetFloat(1.0) component("green"):SetFloat(1.0) component("blue"):SetFloat(1.0)
component("layer"):SetString("HUD");
--[[component("text"):SetString("100%")]]
